gancho: Nāmaka, the goddess of the sea, finally catches her sister Pele on Maui. Fire fights sea face to face, and Pele's body is torn apart. Her bones are still pointed out on Maui's coast, but her spirit blazes over the mountains of Hawaiʻi, and she finds a home the sea can never reach: Kīlauea. Based on N. B. Emerson, Pele and Hiiaka (1915), and W. D. Westervelt, Hawaiian Legends of Volcanoes (1916).
